name: Spectrum
author: HamDash
description: Live spectrum and waterfall of the receiver's audio

device.label: Audio input
device.help: Part of the input's name, e.g. 'USB Audio CODEC'. Blank uses the system default. 'mock' synthesises a test signal so the card works with no radio attached; the card page lists the inputs it can see.

max_hz.label: Show up to (Hz)
max_hz.help: An SSB passband is about 300-2700 Hz, so there is rarely anything above 3500.

auto_scale.label: Auto contrast
auto_scale.help: Track the noise floor automatically. Sound card levels vary by tens of dB, so a fixed floor is wrong on most machines. Turn off to use the two values below.

floor_db.label: Noise floor (dB)
floor_db.help: Only used when auto contrast is off. Anything at or below this is background.

ceil_db.label: Full scale (dB)
ceil_db.help: Only used when auto contrast is off. Anything at or above this is full brightness.
